title: DRAMA: Dissecting Attention Redundancy for Accelerating Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional attention, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive vision-language modeling. However, each denoising step requires a full forward pass over long multimodal sequences in which visual tokens dominate the sequence length, and a fixed step budget further compounds this quadratic per-step cost. Existing inference acceleration approaches for multimodal dLLMs characterize attention redundancy implicitly, motivating designs from isolated attention visualizations rather than from measurement. translated_title: DRAMA：剖析注意力冗余以加速多模态扩散大语言模型
translated_abstract: 多模态扩散大语言模型通过基于双向注意力的迭代式掩码去噪来生成文本，为自回归视觉-语言建模提供了一种极具吸引力的替代方案。然而，每个去噪步骤都需要对长多模态序列进行完整的正向传播，其中视觉标记占据序列长度的主要部分，而固定的步骤预算进一步加剧了这种每步二次方的计算成本。现有的多模态dLLM推理加速方法只是隐式地刻画注意力冗余，其设计往往基于孤立的注意力可视化而非实际测量。我们通过DRAMA来填补这一空白，这是一个无需训练的加速框架，其建立在对多模态dLLM中注意力冗余进行系统性剖析的基础上。通过沿空间和时间轴探测注意力张量，我们揭示了两种持续存在的冗余结构：(i) 注意力质量始终集中在稀疏的视觉……
tldr: DRAMA是一个无需训练的多模态扩散大语言模型加速框架，通过系统性剖析注意力在空间与时间维度上的冗余结构（如注意力质量持续集中于稀疏视觉标记），实现高效推理加速。
en_tdlr: DRAMA is a training-free acceleration framework for multimodal diffusion LLMs that systematically dissects attention redundancy along spatial and temporal axes, revealing persistent structures such as attention mass concentrating on sparse visual tokens to enable faster inference.
